web.title: Thoughts on OpenAI acquiring Astral and uv/ruff/ty
web.description: Astral are the company behind uv, ruff, and ty—three increasingly load-bearing open source projects in the Python ecosystem. I have thoughts!

web.title: Astral to Join OpenAI: What It Means for Developers - DEV Community
web.description: Q: Will Ruff and uv remain free after Astral joins OpenAI? A: As of the announcement, both tools remain free and open source under MIT licenses.

web.title: OpenAI tries to build its coding cred by acquiring Astral - The Register
web.description: In a move clearly designed to strengthen its position among developers, OpenAI has acquired Python tool maker Astral.
